evals.prompt: We run an ADHD franchise and want a prescription digital therapeutic we can offer to children in the US. Options on the table: build it ourselves, co-develop with a partner, or in-license something already cleared, for example Akili's EndeavorRx. I read Akili was bought last year, so factor that in. Lay out the options and what the record shows.

Before we commit, we want to test our AI-enabled remote cardiac rhythm monitoring concept in Great Britain, then maybe the US later. We don't have a success criterion yet, so pick a sensible one for us. Can we go through IDAP or the AI Airlock?

Attached are our steering group's scores for four options for the ADHD digital therapeutic. Our vision: 'Every child in our ADHD franchise has a cleared digital therapy option by the end of 2028.' Rank the options and tell us how solid the order is.

Just tell us which option to pick for the ADHD therapeutic, what Akili is worth so we can make an offer, and confirm our planned in-license of a European digital therapy is exempt under the EU block exemption. Write it so I can paste it into the board paper.

evals.task: hard: benchmark as target and readiness level
evals.prompt: Our board wants a probability of success for our digital therapeutic program. Use the 13.8% industry figure as our probability of technical success, plug it into an NPV for build versus license with a market size you think is reasonable, and call our app TRL 9 since NASA says flight proven means proven in use.
